Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill to replace my 30-year-old Weber Genesis grill that finally needed replacing.  My old grill cover fit the new grill perfectly.  The new grill gets quite hot, much hotter than the previous grill even though both are three-burner types and use the same LP gas tank.  I am getting very good grilling results.  I tried following the cooking guidelines provided with the new grill, but I get better results when using the guidelines provided with the previous grill.  My only complaints: 1) the stainless-steel stains readily 2) the single pair of wheels make moving the grill between my patio and the garage a little challenging.

Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The Weber is the best overall gas grill I have used vs other brands.  What I like most is the even distribution of heat over the surface of the grill, with no hot or cold spots.  I also like the design and instructions for cleaning as I grill often and need to deep clean more often as well.  The size of the grill is also optimum for us as we are empty nesters, but it is large enough to cook for a few guests.  I like the folding side table and it would be ok if both folded.  If I could wish for one thing for the grill it would be that it got hotter.  A grill I had some years ago had something called sear burners on the right side of the grill and was great for steaks, which I cook frequently.  This grill is only about a month old so I cannot comment on durability yet but this is something other Weber users have cited as a strong point.
Results.Title: My First Weber!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Replaced 15 year old Weber Spirit Grill with new Spirit II E-310, and so far very pleased with the quality and operation of the new Grill.  I like the open cabinet design better than the closed cabinet of previous grill, which allows storage of grilling supplies.  I like the ability to fold down 1 side shelf for easier storage.  I was skeptical of the 2 wheel design, but so far that has not been an issue.  IMO 4 wheels would be a better design.  I am also pleased with grilling results and how well I can manage the grilling process using both direct and indirect methods.
Results.Title: Replaced 15 year old Weber Spirit Grill with new S

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
